question: Oda-sensei! Good day! I have a quick question for you. Are the names "Kuina" (Rallidae) and "Tashigi" (Snipe) actually taken from the names of birds? Please tell us! By Bird Encyclopedia Checker.
answer: That's right. More specifically, they are the names of birds that cannot fly. But just because they say a bird cannot fly, doesn't mean that it never will. After all, I saw a duck fly in an anime I watched when I was little, called "[http://Wikipedia:The_Wonderful_Adventures_of_Nils_(TV_series) The Wonderful Adventures of Nils]". By the way, Nojiko (Yellow Bunting) is a bird's name, too.
